sections.label: Singapore contributions to IDA
sections.summary: Singapore has contributed to IDA's replenishments since 2002 as a member of IDA.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (on behalf of the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: As a member of IDA, Singapore has contributed to IDA's replenishments since 2002.

sections.label: IDA cap and section 4
sections.summary: The current cap is US$1.3 million, about S$1.85 million, and section 4 amendments require Parliament's approval for every additional IDA subscription.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (on behalf of the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The current cap is US$1.3 million, equivalent to about S$1.85 million.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (on behalf of the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The amendments to section 4 will require the Government to seek Parliament's approval for every additional subscription to IDA, instead of approving the cap for the cumulative amount of contributions.

sections.label: Next IDA subscription approval
sections.summary: If Parliament approves this Bill, the Government plans to separately seek Parliament's approval for the next IDA subscription in 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (on behalf of the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: If Parliament approves this Bill, we plan to separately seek Parliament's approval for our next subscription to IDA in 2023.

sections.label: World Bank loans to Singapore
sections.summary: As a Third World country in early Independence, Singapore benefited from World Bank loans for nation-building and key infrastructure such as its port.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: As Prof Hoon shared in his speech, when Singapore was a Third World country in the early years of our Independence, we had benefited from loans provided by the World Bank to finance our nation-building and key infrastructure, such as our port.

sections.label: Singapore support for World Bank
sections.summary: Singapore will support the World Bank in assisting disadvantaged economies, and IDA will help neighbours like Laos and Cambodia.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: As a responsible member of the international community, Singapore will continue to do our part to support the World Bank in assisting disadvantaged economies finance their long-term development needs, including initiatives to mitigate the effects of climate change, and to build stronger resilience against future pandemics and natural disasters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Within our region, IDA will also help some of our neighbours like Laos and Cambodia.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: As Prof Hoon Hian Teck said, a stable and economically vibrant ASEAN will benefit all countries in the region, including Singapore.
